blockDetails.summary: CodeArts documentation said text-only, but the local kernel log showed multimodalModels includes glm-5.3-flash and sent a 42 KB image payload. Local fix verified after correcting the provider metadata. Opened https://github.com/example/codearts-plugins/issues/7.

The magpie provider advertised a model as text-only while the upstream model accepted images. Local fix updated the provider model metadata; upstream patch opened https://github.com/example/magpie/pull/12.

blockDetails.topic: OpenCode plugin setup and idle handlers
blockDetails.summary: opencode plugin setup() ran 6-15 times in a long-lived session; each call added another event.subscribe, so session.idle duplicated 5-7 times. Local fix used a global claim map.
An MCP server launched through npx left an orphan process after the session ended. The process tree survived taskkill of the parent; a direct node entry fixed the cleanup path. Local fix verified.
Clearing Word Range.Text removed paragraph marks and mixed up 16 images in the report. The caller fixed the range boundaries; the document structure and table of contents still need validation.
The SRT timestamps covered the first and last lines, but episode mapping skipped two parts. Local fix added a coverage report and a timestamp check; no upstream library change was needed.
The model exposed reasoning variants in the router, but the provider did not advertise effort levels. The UI hid the selector. Local fix added none, low, high, max metadata.

The AOA converter produced extra junction events and dummy arrows for two textbook exercises: 7 events and 3 dummies became 9 and 5. The existing tests only checked reachability, not the expected topology.
dsh desktop exited with STATUS_BREAKPOINT under a low integrity token. The Electron process could not create the userData lock file; running from a medium integrity shell avoided the crash.
A billion-context session grew past the compression window; the proxy was unavailable and the direct request was too large. The user rebuilt the proxy lane and the 413 disappeared.
A second session confirmed that the same CodeArts model accepted a native multimodal image while the public description still said text-only. Local fix verified.
